project_type: FileForgeWorkbench -- Rust/egui desktop workbench (an ISPF-inspired mainframe-style editor). Cargo workspace; the GUI binary crate is ff-desktop (entry src/main.rs), with GUI-free logic crates like ff-line-commands.
build_system: Cargo workspace. All work is in the EXISTING worktree c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/group-b-alias (branch group-b-alias, based on main at 5cedf0c). Run cargo with --manifest-path c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/group-b-alias/Cargo.toml (or cwd into the worktree). The shared target/ build dir can be LOCK-CONTENDED with the owner's runs; on 'Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory' just wait/retry -- it is not an error.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[test] + egui_kittest for full-shell GUI behaviour (harness_shell / build_eframe). Tests live in #[cfg(test)] mod tests inside source files and in dedicated shell/tests_*.rs files.
verification_instructions: Per .kiro/steering/gate-policy.md and testing.md the AGENT verifies SCOPED only: (1) cargo check -p ff-desktop; (2) cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings; (3) cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check; (4) cargo test -p ff-desktop <scoped filter> for the touched modules (alias_editor, ispf_table_editor, user_aliases, tests_focus, tests_editor_snapshot_tables) where quick. Do NOT run the whole-workspace cargo test / cargo gate -- those wedge the terminal and are the OWNER's manual run. TDD: write the failing test first, confirm it fails, then implement. Verify by EFFECT (read logs/result files), never trust a bare 'Exit Code: -1' (a capture artifact -- the command very often succeeded).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this task. No snapshot images are regenerated; the egui_kittest tests here assert focus ids and ScreenModel table contents, not pixel snapshots.
environment_constraints: Terminal: a PreToolUse proxy runs commands via C:\tools\scripts\run_terminal.py and writes a RESULT FILE under C:\Users\A142367\.kiro\terminal-log\results\ -- READ that file for real output; a raw ';'-chained line is BLOCKED by a guard hook (run one command per invocation). Use pwsh7 (C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command). Build/test commands can run minutes; the proxy elevates their timeout. Never push; never merge; STOP before merge. Resolver MUST stay a linear scan (do not change AliasTable to a map/binary search -- that is an owner-confirmed framework change and is explicitly out of scope).
contribution_requirements: No source .rs file over 400 NON-TEST lines (.kiro/steering/rust-standards.md) -- split before adding; split a #[cfg(test)] mod into a sibling file before it alone exceeds ~200 lines. ASCII-only in docs and pattern-matched source (documentation-charset.md). Build ON the framework (framework-conformance.md): no new dispatcher, no second navigation stack, no reshape of a core framework type; an additive #[serde(default)] optional field is NOT a framework change and is pre-approved here (Req 7 OWNER-CONFIRM option (a)). ISPF explicit-commit save convention (save-convention.md): working copy; SAVE commits+stays, END commits+exits, CANCEL/RETURN discards+exits, REFRESH discards+reloads -- all already wired via the CR-CH-071 editable_context seam; do not add a second save path. WorkspaceContext focus contract (workspace-conformance.md): report InteriorFocus through the single render_workspace_context latch path; the first interior control is the FILTER CE dropdown.
key_patterns: Pure-render + action pattern (CR-NR-078): a Context's render returns an action + InteriorFocus; the shell owns the panel via mem::take -> render_workspace_context -> put back -> apply_<editor>_action (see shell/render_body.rs TabKind::AliasEditor arm). State-changing intent is a stashed pending_action, NOT direct shell mutation from render, and NOT the ShellRequest vocabulary. Line-command engine reuse: ff-line-commands exposes LineCommandParser::parse(&str, line_u64) -> ParsedLineCommand{line,kind}, command::classify(&LineCommandKind) -> LineCommandCategory (Immediate/Block/Source/Target), and LineCommandKind variants (Insert, Delete, Copy, Move, After, Before, Repeat, ...). The shared component classifies Act letters through these -- it adds NO new parser. Alias store is CR-CH-072: one <ENV>.toml file per environment under <base>/<locale>/; the row shape is surface/canonical/command_template (+ environment from the file name, #[serde(skip)]); there is NO localisation_key (the task brief's description of that field is stale -- trust the code). The alias sort key is the resolver's match key: surface.to_uppercase() ascending, stable, canonical as tie-break, scoped per environment (the store is already per-env, so write_override_rows just sorts each env's Vec before serialise). Manual SORT and auto-sort-on-save MUST share one key function so their ordering is identical.
